live.momentous on October 29, 2026: "Unfortunately, "you can't out-train a poor diet."

Protein may get the attention, but for plant-based athlete @richroll, fiber matters just as much. 🌱

Catch up on his road to the @nycmarathon before race day this Sunday. The full series is now on YouTube.

📺 Watch the playlist at the link in bio.".
